subject.title: /mcp show leaks raw MCP server credentials (env/headers) into group chats

question: Should this public credential-exposure report be handled through central security review, and should the permanent fix combine MCP output redaction with group-to-private routing?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but credential exposure touches the repository security boundary and the final mitigation should be security-owned rather than staged as an unapproved repair job.

options.title: Redact and route privately
options.body: Redact secret-shaped MCP fields before rendering and send sensitive `/mcp show` output privately when invoked from a group.

options.title: Redact only
options.body: Mask `env`, `headers`, sensitive URLs, and secret-shaped values in `/mcp show` while leaving delivery in the invoking chat.

options.title: Private route only
options.body: Keep full server details but send them to an owner DM for group invocations, accepting that raw secrets may still appear in command output elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Redact and route privately
recommendation.body: Redact secret-shaped MCP fields before rendering and send sensitive `/mcp show` output privately when invoked from a group.

likelyOwner.reason: The current command handler, sibling private-route surfaces, and MCP redaction history all route most directly through this recent area contributor.
